choices.content: The highest point (peak) of the curve
The lowest point of the curve
The intersection of the curve with the horizontal axis

question.prompt: In the Northern Hemisphere, daylight is longest on the summer solstice. How is this shown on a trend chart? (The vertical axis represents daylight duration, and the horizontal axis represents the date.)

solutions.explanation: The maximum daylight duration corresponds to the point on the curve with the greatest vertical coordinate, namely the highest point (peak).
solutions.title: Interpret the vertical axis
